units.source_text: 自豪必须是更轻松的、明朗的、肉眼清晰可见的、光灿灿的东西。

en.t: Pride had to be something lighter, brighter, plainly visible to the naked eye, and radiant.

units.source_text: 我需求肉眼看得见的东西，需求谁都看得见的成为我的自豪的东西。

en.t: I wanted something I could see with my own eyes, something anyone could see and that could become my pride.

units.source_text: 比如说，他腰间佩带的短剑正是这样的东西。

en.t: For example, the short sword he wore at his waist was exactly that sort of thing.
